shots.prompt: Realistic vertical smartphone video, natural bathroom light, handheld feel. A German woman in her late fifties with short silver-grey hair and a light grey patterned blouse stands at the bathroom mirror and smiles at herself; a small white blob of denture adhesive cream squeezes out at the corner of her mouth onto her lip. She notices it, her smile drops and she looks embarrassed. Quiet bathroom room tone, no music, no speech.
